note: Versions below were checked against npm, PyPI, GitHub release notes, and public advisories on this date. Null pins are intentionally unpinned. Do not invent a version at study time; read the registry.

full_study.why: Reference filesystem server. Vulnerable pin is inside the CVE-2025-53109 and CVE-2025-53110 range. Patched pin is the 2.0.0 release published with modelcontextprotocol/servers v2.0.0. The live study runs only 2.0.0.

GitHub advisories: CVE-2025-68143 is < 2025.9.25 (patched 2025.9.25); CVE-2025-68144 and CVE-2025-68145 are < 2025.12.18 (patched 2025.12.18). The CVE records for those two say < 2025.12.17. CVE-2026-27735 is < 2026.1.14 (patched 2026.1.14). fixed_minimum is the GitHub patch date for CVE-2025-68144 and CVE-2025-68145 only. The live study runs 2026.10.19 only. No vulnerable pin is chosen. Run any older pin only inside a jail.
The live study runs 2026.10.19 without --allow-private-ips. That pin refuses loopback, link-local, private, and file URLs. An older pin that lacks the check was not identified in this pass.
File-backed knowledge graph. The live study found no path argument; MEMORY_FILE_PATH fixes the file, and the wiggle room is entity names, search queries, and unused tools.
